title: NEXARA Runtime Integration — Architecture Design V1
description: Defines how the 5-plane architecture (Control, Execution, Capability, Provider, Tool) integrates with NexaraRuntime V2. Design only — no implementation.

pr24_baseline.what_kma_added: MemoryKernel idempotency, EvidenceStore public API, CircuitBreaker consolidation, KnowledgeService supersession, ChiefBrainKernel recall()
pr24_baseline.what_5_planes_add: Structured agent lifecycle, capability-driven routing, provider-agnostic selection, tool sandbox, evidence chain

contracts.role: Design contracts — JSON schemas, validators, type definitions

runtime.role: NEW additive layer — plane controllers, adapters, bridges
runtime.location: src/nexara_prime/ — NEW files only, no existing file modification

memory.role: MemoryKernel — knowledge persistence with evidence binding

existing_files_protected: src/nexara_prime/tools.py — ToolRuntime (read only, wrapped by adapter)
src/nexara_prime/capabilities.py — CapabilityRegistry (read only, extended by resolver)

nexara_runtime_v2.description: NexaraRuntime V2 adds 6 new modules as additive platform layer above V1. Existing runtime unchanged.

mission_runtime.purpose: Control Plane controller — state transitions, lease management, heartbeat monitoring

provider_router.purpose: Provider adapter registry + multi-dim scoring + selection

tool_adapter.purpose: Tool registry runtime — capability-gated tool dispatch

execution_controller.purpose: Execution Plane controller — agent dispatch, lease enforcement, failure recovery

mission_execution: 1. Mission received → MissionLifecycleController creates mission, transitions to CREATED
2. CapabilityResolver resolves mission needs → capabilities → providers
4. Agent invokes tools through ToolRegistry → ToolRuntime → sandbox
5. EvidenceStore records every state transition, tool invocation, and artifact
6. CrossRefValidator checks evidence chain integrity at each gate
7. WAITING_REVIEW → independent reviewer evaluates → VERIFYING → COMPLETED
failure_recovery: 3. SYSTEM transitions to BLOCKED or FAILED
5. New agent replays from checkpoint with idempotency_key
evidence_flow: 6. All evidence in EvidenceStore → append-only, SHA256-verified

migration_strategy.from: PR24 KMA (a0f9d16b) — direct Runtime calls, implicit agent roles
migration_strategy.to: NexaraRuntime V2 — structured planes, explicit capability routing

phases.phase_1_target: Implement 6 new modules in src/nexara_prime/. Zero existing file modifications.
phases.phase_2_target: Wire Execution Plane to Tool Runtime. Migration of existing missions to structured lifecycle.
phases.phase_3_target: Provider adapter registry. Capability-driven provider selection replacing hardcoded model choices.
phases.compatibility: Existing Runtime API unchanged. All existing tests (1029+) continue to PASS. New tests added for new modules.

risk_mitigation: Each new module is independently testable (71 validator tests already pass)
Existing Runtime frozen — no regressions possible
Rollback: delete new files, revert to V1 Runtime
